resolution: The world was not dropping couch_002's texture: Export silently armed the newest saved Painting 1 skin, whose nine-color atlas exactly matched the bright cyan/pink/yellow placement, while Studio displayed the current purple base atlas. The authored palette now always exposes the current Studio look first, keeps every named painting as a separate selectable placeable, and Export arms Current instead of silently substituting a saved variant. Focused authored-registry tests, editor TypeScript check, and the ReleaseFast editor ship all pass.
